query:
MATCH (d:Document)-[:HAS_CHUNK]->(c:DocumentChunk)
WHERE c.CommunityId IS NOT NULL
RETURN c.CommunityId AS community_id,
       collect(DISTINCT d.filename) AS files_in_community,
       count(c) AS chunk_count
ORDER BY size(files_in_community) DESC, chunk_count DESC;
